The first release of **Toon Studio** — formerly Comic Translate — with a new look and a full set of editing tools for typesetting and cleaning pages.

Your settings, glossaries, prompts, workspaces and `.ctpr` projects carry over unchanged: everything that stores data keeps its old name on purpose.

## ดาวน์โหลด / Download

| | |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `ToonStudio-Windows-x86_64.zip` — แตกไฟล์แล้วเปิด `ToonStudio.exe` / unzip and run `ToonStudio.exe` |
| Linux (x86_64) | `ToonStudio-Linux-x86_64.tar.gz` — แตกไฟล์แล้วรัน `./ToonStudio/ToonStudio` |

AI models download on first use, not at install time.

## มีอะไรใหม่ / What's new

**Toon Studio**
- New name, app icon and dark/light theme; the editor is laid out as a step bar, a tool rail, an options bar, an inspector (Text · Layers · Glossary) and a status bar.
- A Stitch page joins raw webtoon slices and re-cuts them at empty rows, so no bubble is split across two pages.

**Text** (ข้อความ)
- Stacked strokes, shadow opacity, and rich text (per-range colour and font) that survives curves and warps.
- Four-corner perspective and skew; six warp styles — arc, arch, bulge, flag, wave, rise.
- Style presets (Speech, Shout, Thought, Narration, SFX, plus your own) and a default style for newly rendered text.
- A Type tool for placing your own text boxes; font favourites.

**Selection** (เลือกพื้นที่)
- A real selection with marching ants: rectangle, magic wand, lasso/polygon, and one-click balloon select.
- Shift adds, Alt subtracts; grow, shrink, smooth and feather; Clean Selection paints a flat bubble's lettering out without touching its outline.

**Cleaning** (ลบภาพ)
- Paint brush and restore eraser with pen pressure; eyedropper.
- Fill bucket that leaves lettering and outlines alone.
- AI inpaint brush: paint over anything to remove it, with no separate Clean step.
- Clone stamp (aligned, lock offset) and healing brush.
- Clean White Balloons: one click removes the lettering of every plain white bubble on the page, without the AI; textured bubbles are skipped and reported.
- Every edit is an undoable patch in the Layers panel; the original page is never changed.

**Layers, glossary and export**
- A Photoshop-style layer stack: visibility, lock, opacity and order per object, kept in projects and in PSD export.
- Glossary matching that copes with OCR spacing and one-letter misreads, overlap warnings, and a check that flags translations which ignored the glossary.
- PSD export: text layers stay editable and now show their pixels in Photopea; oversized pages are written as PSB.

## แก้บั๊ก / Fixes
- The window could not fit a 1366×768 screen (minimum height 932 px); the tool rail now scrolls.
- The app could freeze at startup while an update check finished; and every closed window left an application-wide event filter behind, slowing the whole app.
- Overlapping cleaning patches were composed in the wrong order for OCR and inpainting.
- Webtoon pages of different widths got boxes shifted sideways.
